title: Lovestruck — First Song Releasing Tomorrow
presentedBy: TRIO — Set of Three Arts, in association with Shemaroo
summary: A timeless journey through the heart's landscape — TRIO's ghazal album Lovestruck drops its first song tomorrow on Shemaroo.
description: TRIO — Set of Three Arts presents Lovestruck, a timeless journey through the heart's landscape. Produced by Sheeba Lateef and directed by Altamash Abbas, the album brings together an extraordinary line-up of voices — Anup Jalota, Talat Aziz, Shaan, Jaspinder Narula, Mahalakshmi Iyer, Shahid Mallya, Jaswinder Singh, Prithvi Gandharva, and Niti D Jain. Music composed, arranged and mastered by Prem Murti, with lyrics by Kashif Raza, Sheeba Lateef, Altamash Abbas, and Faraz Faani. The first song releases tomorrow on Shemaroo.
